subject: Access ownership ledger and SAML/SCIM evidence request — HealthBridge
messages:
From: Li Wei <li.wei@healthbridge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthBridge Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access ownership ledger + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/SOC2

Hi Tessa,

We're working through the SIG & SOC2 evidence requests for our security review and need a few artifacts from Redwood to complete the intake. Can you please provide the following by COB Thursday (Oct 22)?

- Account ownership mapping for our tenant (primary owner, delegated owners) — CSV or spreadsheet.
- Export of RBAC roles and the current assignment list (role name + user or group) for the last 90 days.
- A small sample of SAML assertion responses (redacted PII but full attribute names) from successful logins.
- A SCIM delta log sample showing user create/update/delete activity over the past 30 days.
- Notes on how orphaned accounts are identified and remediated.

If you can also point us to any policy docs or a short checklist for least-privilege reviews, that would be helpful.

We may share these with our procurement and security teams; confidentiality is understood. If there's a more appropriate contact at Redwood for artifact delivery, loop them in.

Thanks,
Li Wei
Security Program Manager
HealthBridge
li.wei@healthbridge.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Li Wei <li.wei@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 13:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access ownership ledger + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/SOC2

Li — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver all of the items you requested. High-level plan:

- Access snapshot (owner mappings + role assignments): attached CSV 'access-snapshot-20261018.csv' — redacted personal emails per our data handling policy, includes role assignments and owner column.
- RBAC export: will include role definitions + assignment snapshots; delivery as CSV and a short README explaining transient roles.
- SAML assertions: we'll provide sanitized examples (attribute names preserved, values replaced) as a text file.
- SCIM delta sample: zipped sample of delta events for the past 30 days.
- Orphaned accounts: brief note below and a path to run the owner reconciliation job.

Quick answers now:
- Orphan detection: nightly job compares last activity, owner assignment, and provisioning source (SCIM vs manual). Accounts without an owner for 14+ days are flagged and routed to the customer owner inbox; automated disable is configurable per tenant.
- Least-privilege checklist: we'll link a short checklist and share recommended role-pruning cadence.

If this format works, we'll push the sanitized SAML and SCIM samples to the Drive folder (link below) and send a follow-up with the RBAC export. Do you want PII redaction at the username level (user--redacted) or keep full user_ids?

Drive for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcDeFGhIJkLmnoPqRsT

Attachments: access-snapshot-20261018.csv (CSV, redacted)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Li Wei <li.wei@healthbridge.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:20:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access ownership ledger + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/SOC2

Li — looping in the small artifact set. A couple of implementation notes below.

Attachments: saml-assertion-examples.txt (text), scim-delta-sample.zip (zip)

Notes:
- SAML assertions: the attached file contains three redacted assertions (success flows) with attribute names preserved. We removed any full_name and email values and replaced with placeholders (e.g., user_123). Audience and recipient still intact.
- SCIM delta: zipped sample includes create/update/delete events in JSONL; event timestamps are preserved.
- RBAC export: we created a CSV dump in the Drive folder (see link) titled 'healthbridge_rbac_export_20261018.csv' — it contains role name, role id, permission list (short), and assignment_count. Full assignment mappings are in the 'access-snapshot' CSV Tessa attached.

A few technical clarifications that help your reviewers:
- Orphan remediation: when an account is flagged, our platform emails the configured tenant owners and opens a ticket in the customer-visible audit log. The default policy is manual remediation with a 14-day auto-disable option.
- Password resets: Redwood does not store customer passwords for SSO flows; we can provide last authentication timestamps and last_password_change metadata where available from our auth logs.

I'll also create a short JIRA item for this evidence hand-off: SUP-1234.

-Rishi
Principal Applied ML Engineer (Identity & Controls)
Redwood Inference

Tessa/Rishi — received, thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifact set. Procurement and security have what they need for now. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) On the access-snapshot CSV: can you include the last_auth_timestamp column in the next export (even if null for SCIM-provisioned service accounts)?
2) On orphan remediation: do you have a short blurb (one paragraph) we can paste into our SOC2 workpaper explaining the 14-day flag + owner-notification process?

If you can drop both into the Drive folder, we'll close the item on our side. Appreciate the support.

Thanks,
Li Wei
